seeded.note: Seeded 2026-11-03 from official documents opened in this session. On San Francisco ballots: the San Francisco Department of Elections' Voter Information Pamphlet for the November 3, 2026 Consolidated General Election (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/N26_EN_VIP.pdf, src:media-api-sf-gov-e4221ecde7) lists "Assessor-Recorder" under "Local Offices that use Ranked-Choice Voting" (p. 4) and describes the office on p. 23; its ballot worksheet lists it under "CITY AND COUNTY (elected using ranked-choice voting)" (p. 247). Candidate: the Department's Board of Supervisors and Other Local Offices Chinese-character-based Names and Ballot Designations List (https://api.sf.gov/documents/63094/November_2026_Local_Office_Names_and_Ballot_Designations.pdf, src:api-sf-gov-cd997081d7) prints JOAQUÍN TORRES with the ballot designation "Incumbent" under "Assessor-Recorder"; the pamphlet prints the name as "Joaquín Torres" with the candidate's statement (p. 38). The Department of Elections' page Candidates - November 3, 2026, General Election (https://www.sf.gov/candidates-november-3-2026-general-election, src:sf-gov-6871cf14b5) lists the name without the accent, "Joaquin Torres", under "Assessor-Recorder" with the wording "1 person(s) have filed for candidacy for this contest on the November 3, 2026 ballot." (the page says "have qualified" for most other contests). The Candidates page also lists "Write-In Candidates" with "0 people have filed for candidacy for this contest on the November 3, 2026 ballot." No office record for the Assessor-Recorder exists in data/offices, so office_ref is not set. No stance questions are set yet.
